title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available on Unity Gateway
body:
OpenAI [GPT-6.2 Astra](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#openai-gpt-6-2-astra) and [GPT-6.2 Sol](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#openai-gpt-6-2-sol) are now available on Unity Gateway. You can access these models using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Both models support text and image inputs, function calling, reasoning, and priority pay-per-token.

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
